WELDER (FIRST CLASS) – FULL TIME
Business: DUDIALA ENTERPRISES PTY LTD 
ABN: 67 635 325 192
Trading Name: Universal Metal Fabrication
Location: Unit 2, 42 COLBERT ROAD, CAMPBELLFIELD VIC 3061
Salary: AU$79,500 – AU$85,000 per annum + Superannuation (commensurate with qualifications and experience)
Employment Type: Full-time (minimum 38 hours per week)

Job Published: 18 July 2026 


ABOUT THE BUSINESS
Universal Metal Fabrication is an established Australian metal fabrication business specialising in the design, manufacture, modification, repair, and servicing of custom truck bodies, transport equipment, and fabricated metal components. Operating from Campbellfield, Victoria, the business provides fabrication solutions to commercial transport operators and businesses requiring purpose-built vehicle bodies, structural modifications, repairs, and associated metal fabrication services.
The business undertakes a broad range of fabrication activities including structural steel fabrication, first-class welding, cutting, assembly, fitting, repairs, and the manufacture of custom truck bodies and specialised transport equipment. Operations involve interpreting engineering drawings, fabricating and assembling steel components, performing precision welding, and ensuring completed products meet Australian industry standards, quality requirements, and customer specifications.
Universal Metal Fabrication services clients across the transport, logistics, commercial, and industrial sectors, delivering custom fabrication solutions tailored to individual operational requirements. The business maintains a strong commitment to quality workmanship, workplace safety, operational efficiency, and timely project delivery while continuing to invest in innovation, modern fabrication techniques, and continuous improvement to meet evolving industry requirements.
I would use this version. It reads as a genuine business profile rather than marketing copy, aligns closely with the company's website, and provides a solid factual foundation for a Welder (First Class) (ANZSCO 322313) nomination.

ABOUT THE ROLE
An opportunity exists for an experienced Welder (First Class) (ANZSCO 322313) to join the business on a full-time basis.
This is a hands-on trade position responsible for carrying out a broad range of welding and metal fabrication activities within a workshop and, where required, onsite project environments. The successful candidate will be responsible for interpreting technical drawings, preparing materials, welding fabricated components, inspecting completed work, and supporting the efficient delivery of fabrication projects while maintaining high standards of workmanship and safety.
The position requires the ability to work independently and collaboratively within a fabrication team, maintain production quality, and contribute to the timely completion of engineering and fabrication projects.
This is a permanent full-time position based on a minimum 38-hour working week.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Fabrication Preparation and Material Processing
•	Interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, specifications, and work instructions to determine fabrication and welding requirements.
•	Select, inspect, clean, and prepare metal stock and fabricated components for welding.
•	Measure, mark, and cut steel, aluminium, stainless steel, and other metals using hand tools, flame cutting equipment, power tools, and metal cutting machinery.
•	Shape, bend, and prepare metal sections, pipes, and fabricated components using appropriate manual and mechanical techniques.
•	Prepare workpieces to ensure accurate fit-up prior to welding.

Welding and Fabrication
•	Align, position, and secure fabricated components using measuring equipment, clamps, jigs, and hand tools.
•	Perform welding using appropriate processes including MIG, TIG, Arc (MMAW), and other welding techniques where required.
•	Join metal components through welding, bolting, riveting, and related fabrication methods.
•	Manufacture, assemble, modify, and repair fabricated metal products in accordance with engineering specifications.
•	Complete fabrication work while maintaining dimensional accuracy, structural integrity, and quality standards.

Quality Assurance and Finishing
•	Inspect completed welds for penetration, bead profile, alignment, strength, and finish quality.
•	Identify and rectify welding defects or fabrication inconsistencies where required.
•	Finish fabricated products through grinding, filing, polishing, cleaning, and other finishing techniques.
•	Ensure completed work complies with project specifications, engineering drawings, and quality requirements.
•	Maintain accurate measurements and workmanship throughout all fabrication activities.

Workshop Operations and Equipment
•	Operate welding equipment, grinders, cutting machinery, lifting equipment, and fabrication tools safely and efficiently.
•	Perform routine maintenance and basic servicing of welding equipment and workshop tools.
•	Maintain clean, organised, and safe work areas throughout fabrication activities.
•	Assist with material handling, storage, and workshop housekeeping.
•	Support efficient workflow to meet production schedules and project deadlines.

Workplace Safety and Compliance
•	Comply with Workplace Health and Safety requirements and safe work procedures at all times.
•	Correctly use personal protective equipment (PPE) and welding safety equipment.
•	Maintain awareness of welding hazards, confined spaces, hot works, and safe handling of materials.
•	Report hazards, equipment faults, and safety concerns promptly.
•	Contribute to maintaining a safe, professional, and compliant workshop environment.

MANDATORY REQUIREMENTS
•	Relevant trade qualification in Engineering Fabrication Trade, Fabrication, Welding, Metal Fabrication, or a closely related discipline, together with at least one (1) year of relevant full-time post-qualification experience; or equivalent skills and experience suitable for the position.
•	Demonstrated experience undertaking welding and metal fabrication activities within an engineering, manufacturing, construction, or fabrication environment.
•	Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, and fabrication specifications.
•	Demonstrated competency using MIG, TIG, Arc (MMAW), or comparable welding processes.
•	Sound understanding of fabrication techniques, welding quality standards, and workshop safety procedures.
•	Ability to work effectively within production schedules while maintaining quality workmanship and attention to detail.

KEY COMPETENCIES
•	Welding and metal fabrication.
•	Interpretation of engineering drawings and technical specifications.
•	Material preparation and fabrication techniques.
•	MIG, TIG and Arc welding capability.
•	Quality control and weld inspection.
•	Workshop operations and equipment handling.
•	Time management and production workflow.
•	Problem-solving and technical judgement.
•	Workplace Health and Safety compliance.
•	Communication, teamwork, and commitment to continuous improvement.

HOW TO APPLY
Please submit a one-page CV outlining your relevant qualifications, experience, and availability.
Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.

Seeking a skilled Panel Beater for full-time employment with a background in the manufacturing & repair industry. 

The Company
We are like one big family here; our team members are the heart of our business.

Sloanebuilt are a leading NSW trailer manufacturer. Our team are committed to the future and have provided many job opportunities for the local community for over 40 years.

We offer opportunities to grow, develop, learn from and work alongside our world-class team of experts. We encourage a culture of respect and reward high performance with an emphasis on quality, performance and reliability.

Sloanebuilt is proud to have a very strong, loyal and committed workforce that is made up of around 140 local employees.
We pride ourselves on our Sloanebuilt values and look for them in each of our valued employees.

Roles to be filled  
We are seeking to appoint highly experienced & skilled candidates for full time employment with a background in the Metal Fabrication Industry for the following positions: 
 
Panel Beaters who have experience in removing damaged panels and parts and removing upholstery and accessories to gain access, removing dents by hammering panels, straightening damaged vehicles and parts using mechanical and hydraulic equipment 
 
Requirements  
To be eligible for this role, applicants must: 
	 Be willing to work a 38 hour week plus overtime based on Company requirements 
	 Have 5 years work experience in a similar role 
	 Self motivated and able to work independently as required 
 
These are specialised trades & 1st class tradespersons need only apply. 
 
The Candidate  
The successful candidate must be someone who prides themselves in producing high quality work with good interpersonal skills with a can-do attitude.  They must be capable of multitasking, organising tasks and can work unsupervised. 
 
Please note, only those candidates successful in the shortlisting process will be contacted in the coming week for interviews. 

Please only apply if you have: 
         - Experience with repairing damage to metal, fibreglass and plastic body work to Heavy Vehicles
	 - Dedicated to maintaining and promoting safe work practices 
	 - Strong commitment to meeting customer requirements 
	- Must hold a trade qualification 
	 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills 
	 - Min 5 years industry experience 
 
High-quality tradesperson need only apply. 

Applicants will only be considered if they have the relevant qualifications and a minimum of 5 years experience within the Trailer Manufacturing Industry.  

Remuneration  
$75,000 - $95,000 per year Dependent on skills & Experience.  
Sloanebuilt Trailers offers regular overtime based on the Companies needs, overtime is additional to the above income range. 
Remuneration can be negotiated with the successful applicant at the interview stage. 

Remuneration will reflect current market conditions and industry award rates. To be discussed with the successful applicant.

Expressions of interest and applications will be accepted for a minimum period of one (1) month from the date this advertisement is first published.

Store/Retail Manager

Coober Pedy Cellar Pty Ltd is seeking an experienced and reliable Retail Manager to oversee the day-to-day management of its liquor retail operations.

The successful candidate will be responsible for managing store operations, improving customer service standards, supporting sales growth, overseeing stock selection, and ensuring the business operates efficiently and in accordance with applicable liquor licensing requirements.

Location: Coober Pedy, South Australia
Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent and Ongoing
Annual Remuneration: $80,000 to $86,000 p.a. plus super.


Key responsibilities

As the Retail Manager, you will be responsible for:

•	Managing the day-to-day store operations. 
•	Developing retail objectives and preparing and implementing operating plans, marketing strategies, advertising initiatives, and store improvement plans
•	Determining the products and brands to be stocked by reviewing product trends, sales trends, and customer preferences
•	Setting prices for merchandise to achieve required profit margins while ensuring compliance with liquor restrictions
•	Achieve financial targets and develop budgets.
•	Selecting suppliers and vendors and placing stock orders within budget
•	Overseeing promotional activities and ensuring effective presentation of products
•	Setting customer service objectives and ensuring high service standards are maintained
•	Managing team.
•	Ensuring the store operates safely, efficiently, and in compliance with relevant laws, policies, and procedures


To be considered for this role, applicants should have:

•	At least 3 years of full time or part time equivalent experience in retail management, preferably within liquor retail or a similar customer-facing retail environment
•	A relevant diploma or higher qualification or at least 3 years of relevant experience in lieu of a qualification
•	Strong knowledge of retail operations, stock control, pricing, sales, and customer service
•	Ability to analyse sales trends and customer preferences
•	Strong communication, leadership, and organisational skills
•	Ability to manage suppliers, budgets, promotions, and day-to-day store operations
•	Understanding of liquor retail compliance requirements
•	Appropriate rights to work in Australia

This is a suitable opportunity for a motivated Retail Manager who can take responsibility for store performance, staff coordination, customer service, and operational standards.
Applications from suitably qualified candidates are encouraged.

Storeperson
VPT Mechanical Solutions
Kalgoorlie-Boulder, WA 6430
Full-time | Permanent
Salary: $80,000 - $85,000 per annum plus superannuation
 
About the Role
 
VPT Mechanical Solutions is seeking a motivated and reliable Storeperson to join our team in Kalgoorlie-Boulder, Western Australia. This full-time position plays an important role in ensuring the efficient receipt, storage, inventory management, and dispatch of materials and equipment to support our operations.
 
Key Responsibilities

Receive, inspect, and verify incoming goods against delivery documentation, reporting any damage or discrepancies.
Unload deliveries and safely unpack, sort, and store stock in designated warehouse locations.
Use computerised inventory systems to record, monitor, and locate stock items.
Label and organise inventory to ensure efficient storage and retrieval.
Prepare, pack, weigh, and securely package goods for dispatch.
Operate forklifts and other materials handling equipment to move, stack, and retrieve stock safely.
Pick and process customer or workshop orders accurately using manual or electronic picking systems.
Assist with routine stocktakes and maintain accurate inventory records.
Maintain a clean, organised, and safe warehouse in accordance with workplace health and safety procedures.
Support the efficient day-to-day operation of the warehouse by ensuring stock is handled accurately and efficiently.


Skills, Qualifications and Experience
To be considered for this position, applicants must meet one of the following:
Hold an AQF Certificate III (or equivalent qualification) in Warehousing Operations, Supply Chain Operations, Logistics, or a related field; or
Have at least three (3) years of full-time relevant work experience as a Storeperson or in a similar warehouse and inventory role.

The successful applicant will also demonstrate:
Experience in warehouse operations, inventory control, and stock management.
Proficiency in using computerised inventory or warehouse management systems.
Ability to safely operate forklifts and other materials handling equipment (a current Forklift Licence is desirable).
Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team.
Good communication skills and a commitment to workplace health and safety.
A reliable work ethic and the ability to prioritise tasks in a fast-paced environment.


What We Offer
Full-time permanent employment.
Competitive annual salary of $80,000 - $85,000 plus superannuation.
A supportive and professional team environment.
Ongoing training and career development opportunities.
Long-term employment with an established and growing company.

Seeking a skilled Engineering Technologist for permanent full-time employment with a background in the Heavy Vehicle Manufacturing Industry.

The Company
We are like one big family here; our team members are the heart of our business.
Sloanebuilt are a leading NSW trailer manufacturer. Our team are committed to the future and have provided many job opportunities for the local community for over 40 years.
We offer opportunities to grow, develop, learn from and work alongside our world-class team of experts. We encourage a culture of respect and reward high performance with an emphasis on quality, performance and reliability.
Sloanebuilt is proud to have a very strong, loyal and committed workforce that is made up of around 140 local employees.
We pride ourselves on our Sloanebuilt values and look for them in each of our valued employees.

Roles to be filled
We are seeking to appoint a highly experienced and skilled candidate for full-time employment with a background in the Heavy Vehicle Manufacturing Industry for the following position:

Engineering Technologist who has experience applying engineering technology to support the design and manufacture of heavy vehicle trailers, analysing and improving manufacturing processes and production methods, preparing engineering drawings, technical documentation and specifications, conducting engineering calculations, testing and product validation, investigating production and quality issues and implementing engineering solutions, ensuring compliance with Australian Design Rules (ADR), Australian Standards and customer requirements, and supporting continuous improvement initiatives to improve product performance, manufacturing efficiency and quality.

Requirements
To be eligible for this role, applicants must:
- Be willing to work a 38 hour week.
- Hold a relevant Bachelor's degree or higher qualification in Engineering or a related discipline.
- Have a minimum of 1 year experience as an Engineering Technologist or in a similar engineering role.
- Be self-motivated and able to work independently as required.

The Candidate
The successful candidate must be someone who prides themselves in producing high quality work with good interpersonal skills and a can-do attitude. They must be capable of multitasking, organising tasks and working unsupervised.

Please only apply if you have:
- Relevant Bachelor's degree or higher qualification in Engineering or a related discipline.
- Minimum 1 year's experience as an Engineering Technologist or in a similar engineering role.
- Practical CAD and 3D modelling experience using SolidWorks.
- Practical experience conducting finite element analysis (FEA) using software such as ANSYS.
- Sound knowledge of project management principles, practices, procedures and software.
- Experience interpreting engineering drawings and preparing technical documentation.
- Experience applying engineering technology to develop and improve manufacturing processes, production methods, product performance, and operational efficiency.
- Experience conducting engineering calculations, testing and product validation.
- Experience investigating technical or manufacturing issues and implementing engineering solutions.
- Knowledge of Australian Design Rules (ADR), Australian Standards and engineering compliance requirements.
- Experience with heavy vehicle trailer design, structural steel fabrication or transport equipment manufacturing will be highly regarded.
- Demonstrated ability to work effectively within a team environment.
- Dedicated to maintaining and promoting safe work practices.
- Strong commitment to meeting customer requirements.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- High attention to detail with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Applicants will only be considered if they have the relevant qualifications and experience.

Remuneration
$95,000 - $105,000 per year dependent on skills and experience.

Remuneration can be negotiated with the successful applicant at the interview stage.

Remuneration will reflect current market conditions and industry award rates. To be discussed with the successful applicant.

Please note, only those candidates successful in the shortlisting process will be contacted in the coming weeks for interviews.

Expressions of interest and applications will be accepted for a minimum period of one (1) month from the date this advertisement is first published.

result.description:
NVD Fresh Produce Pty Ltd
Walkaway, Western Australia

Full Time Mobile Plant Operator 
(2 Positions Available)

Salary
AUD $90,000 – $100,000 per annum plus Superannuation, depending on skills and experience.

About us:
NVD Fresh Produce Pty Ltd is a family-owned agricultural enterprise based in Walkaway, Western Australia, approximately 30 minutes from Geraldton. We operate approximately 4.2 hectares of plastic greenhouses in Walkaway and an additional 2 hectares of plastic greenhouses at the family’s original farm.
We are currently expanding our operations, having purchased 60 acres of land near Walkaway to support future growth and long-term sustainability. NVD Fresh Produce specialises in intensive greenhouse cultivation and is progressively diversifying its crop range, recognising crop rotation as a key strategy to preserve soil health, improve productivity, and maintain consistent supply.

The business is focused on strengthening its production capacity, improving operational systems and water management practices, and establishing a scalable and sustainable structure to support ongoing expansion within Western Australia’s fresh produce market.

The successful applicant will play an important role in supporting the continued growth and success of NVD Fresh Produce's farming operations.

Position Summary
The Mobile Plant Operator is responsible for the safe and efficient operation of mobile plant and agricultural machinery to support NVD Fresh Produce's farming operations. The role involves operating and maintaining plant and equipment for land preparation, cultivation, material handling and general farm activities while ensuring workplace safety, operational efficiency and equipment reliability.

Key Responsibilities
Mobile Plant Operations
•	Operate mobile plant and agricultural machinery safely and efficiently in support of farming operations. 
•	Operate machinery for land preparation, cultivation, material handling and general farm activities. 
•	Load, transport and position goods, materials and equipment as required. 
•	Operate machinery in accordance with workplace procedures and manufacturer guidelines. 

Equipment Maintenance
•	Conduct routine pre-start and post-operation inspections of machinery and equipment. 
•	Report mechanical faults, maintenance requirements and safety issues promptly. 
•	Perform routine cleaning and basic daily maintenance of plant and equipment. 
•	Maintain accurate operational and maintenance records where required. 

Farm Operations Support
•	Assist with general farm operations during planting, harvesting and production periods. 
•	Support the movement of equipment, machinery and materials across farm sites. 
•	Work collaboratively with farm managers and other employees to ensure efficient daily operations. 

Workplace Safety
•	Follow workplace health and safety procedures at all times. 
•	Ensure the safe operation of mobile plant and equipment. 
•	Maintain a professional and safety-focused approach while undertaking all duties.

Qualifications and Skills
Applicants should possess one of the following:
•	A relevant AQF Certificate II qualification (or equivalent) together with at least 1 year's relevant post-qualification employment experience (20+ hours per week); or 
•	At least 2 years' relevant employment experience (10+ hours per week) in lieu of a formal qualification, together with an additional 2 years' relevant full-time employment experience. 

In addition, applicants should demonstrate:
•	Experience operating mobile plant and agricultural machinery in a farming, agricultural or horticultural environment. 
•	Ability to operate mobile plant and agricultural machinery safely and efficiently in accordance with workplace procedures. 
•	Ability to perform routine equipment inspections and basic daily maintenance. 
•	Ability to identify and report mechanical faults and maintenance requirements. 
•	Ability to follow work instructions and communicate effectively with supervisors and team members. 
•	Ability to work independently and collaboratively as part of a team. 
•	A current Australian driver's licence is required. 
•	Commitment to workplace health and safety.


How to apply:

Applications open on 10 July 2026 and close on 9 August 2026
Please send your CV to info@businessnest.com.au. Please include the job role title in your email.
